'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Pär Birgander LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Pär Birgander]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

* '''Player:''' [[Pär Birgander]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]

* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-13th-place-ls-par-birgander-ebo/ PC list]
